backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Chapter, ChapterSnapshot, ChapterInput, and PdfEntry types, with CRUD operations for chapters and PDF entries, blob storage for dual audio slots, and data migration support via the Migration module.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms the old Chapter schema (single notes/audio URL) into the new schema with dual notes URLs, dual audio blob slots, and additional label fields during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels — covering frontend type updates, ChapterForm dual-input changes, and notes/audio viewer updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary file describing the purpose and key details of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes (colors, radius, sidebar, charts) applied via the `.dark` class.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Study Sphere Pakistan PWA, loading Inter/Poppins fonts, linking the web manifest, and mounting the React app via `/src/main.tsx`.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Study Sphere Pakistan, defining app name, display mode, theme color, and a single 256×256 PNG icon.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing a cache-first with network-update strategy for same-origin GET requests, pre-caching static assets on install and cleaning up old caches on activate.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application file that configures TanStack Router with all page routes, wraps the app in DarkModeProvider and QueryClientProvider, and controls splash screen display via sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/AdminAuthGuard.t: Empty file intended to contain an admin authentication guard component; currently has no implementation.
frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx: A React audio player component with play/pause, seek, volume, and mute controls, plus an error state with an optional external link fallback.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a chapter showing its title, available features (notes, audio, quiz, flashcards), and a completion checkmark.
frontend/src/components/ChapterForm.tsx: A form component for creating or editing a chapter, supporting title, class, subject, dual notes URLs, two audio file uploads with progress tracking, quiz questions, and flashcards.
frontend/src/components/ClassPage.tsx: An intentionally empty placeholder file indicating that the ClassPage component lives in the pages directory.
frontend/src/components/FlashcardSection: Renders an interactive flashcard deck with flip animation, previous/next navigation, and swipe gesture support for touch devices.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the StudyHub brand, quick navigation links, legal disclaimer, copyright, and a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky site header with logo, desktop and mobile navigation links, a dark mode toggle, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with the Header, Footer, and a full-height main content area via TanStack Router's Outlet.
frontend/src/components/NotesViewer.tsx: Renders an embedded iframe for viewing notes from a URL (with Google Drive preview support), showing empty-state or error-state UI with an 'Open in New Tab' fallback.
frontend/src/components/PdfEntryForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing a PDF entry (title, type, URL), using add/update mutations and rendering a header with cancel/save actions.
frontend/src/components/QuizSection.tsx: Interactive quiz component that steps through questions one at a time, tracks answers, and displays a score summary screen with a retry option.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Full-screen splash screen with animated logo and loading dots that auto-dismisses after 2 seconds with a fade-out transition, then calls onComplete.
frontend/src/contexts/DarkModeContext.ts: React context that persists and toggles dark mode by adding/removing the 'dark' class on the document root and syncing to storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) via React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, login, and logout using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for CRUD operations on chapters and PDF entries, mapping backend responses to frontend types and invalidating relevant caches on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter and Poppins fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes (including flashcard-specific variables), and implements the flashcard 3D flip animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack Query's QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed views for managing chapters and PDF entries, supporting add/edit/delete operations via mutation hooks and switching between list and form sub-views.
frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx: Detail page for a single chapter that displays notes, audio (fetched as binary from the canister actor), quizzes, and flashcards in tabs, while tracking completion and recently viewed state in local storage.
frontend/src/pages/ClassPage.tsx: Subject selection page for a given class number (9–12) that renders a grid of four subject cards (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, English) and navigates to the corresponding subject chapter list.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero section with a search bar, class/MDCAT navigation buttons, and a feature highlights grid showcasing notes, quizzes, flashcards, and other platform capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATPage.tsx: MDCAT preparation hub page that lists subject navigation buttons and dynamically fetches/displays past papers and practice tests from the backend, with delete support for each PDF entry.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATSubjectPage.tsx: Displays a list of MDCAT chapters filtered by subject, with search functionality and a recently viewed section. Navigates to individual chapter pages on click.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectPage.tsx: Displays chapters for a specific class and subject with search and recently viewed functionality. Mirrors MDCATSubjectPage but scoped to class-based navigation.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: A support/donation page that displays an Easypaisa account number with a copy-to-clipboard button and step-by-step sending instructions.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms & Conditions page with static sections covering educational use, affiliations, content changes, external links, and copyright. Includes a hidden admin navigation trigger.
frontend/src/types/chapter.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for frontend data models including Chapter, QuizQuestion, FlashcardItem, and PdfEntry, using string IDs for UI convenience.
frontend/src/utils/audioUploadService.ts: Converts an audio File to a base64 data URL using FileReader, with optional progress callback, for storing audio directly in the canister's audioUrl field.
frontend/src/utils/chapterMapper.ts: Maps backend ChapterSnapshot and PdfEntry types (with bigint IDs and JSON strings) to frontend Chapter and PdfEntry types (with string IDs and parsed arrays).
frontend/src/utils/jsonValidation.ts: Provides validation functions for quiz and flashcard JSON strings, ensuring correct structure and field types, along with example JSON constants for each format.
frontend/src/utils/storageService.ts: Manages device-local user data in localStorage, providing functions to get/add recently viewed chapters, toggle/check completed chapters, and get/set dark mode preference.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode via class, extending the theme with CSS-variable-based colors, custom fonts (Inter, Poppins), border radii, and animations (accordion, fade-in, pulse-ring), plus the animate and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state document (version 29) describing Study Sphere Pakistan's architecture, features, and design decisions, including canister-backed chapter storage, admin panel access pattern, PWA support, and per-chapter notes/audio handling.
